items.t: Russian missiles land in Poland during huge Ukraine strike
items.d: Two missiles and a drone fell in south-east Poland as Russia fired 400+ drones and 110+ missiles at Ukraine. No one was hurt; Tusk called it a deliberate provocation and Poland may seek NATO consultations.

items.t: Iran steps up Gulf attacks; 25 tankers hit in a week
items.d: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they targeted US radars in Bahrain. Around 25 tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz in seven days, briefly pushing oil above $100 before it eased to about $83.

items.t: AI stock rout deepens as Anthropic slips after record IPO
items.d: Anthropic shares fell nearly 10% on their first full trading day, while Nvidia and AMD dropped about 10%. Investors are worrying about stretched valuations and debt-funded data-centre spending.

items.t: Iran holds talks with Qatari mediators in Tehran
items.d: Iran says reopening Hormuz is 'not difficult' if the US ends the war, unfreezes assets and lifts oil sanctions. Trump says he wants a permanent deal; it is not yet formal negotiation.

items.t: Sanctioned Russian cargo ship burns off Finland after drone hit
items.d: The Kaliningrad-bound Sparta II drifted into Finnish waters still on fire; all 16 crew were evacuated. Finland says Ukraine likely struck it and warns the war is spilling into the Baltic.

items.t: Displaced Gazans protest as Israeli strikes continue
items.d: Hundreds protested in Deir el-Balah. Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,661 people have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, and over 500 homes in Maghazi were destroyed in under a month.

items.t: Indonesia sweets factory fire kills 3, with 36 missing
items.d: About 60 people were inside the three-storey factory in Banten, near Jakarta. The fire was still burning after 12 hours; the cause is under investigation.

items.t: Oracle raises $20bn to fund OpenAI data-centre deal
items.d: Oracle priced about $20bn of new shares and bonds and says its huge OpenAI contract is now fully funded, after its stock fell sharply on AI-debt worries.

items.t: Apollo and Goldman price $44bn deal to finance SpaceX GPUs
items.d: The debt pays for Nvidia chips leased to SpaceX, one of the largest AI hardware financings yet, a sign of how much borrowing now backs the AI build-out.

items.t: Databricks in talks to raise money at $225bn valuation
items.d: The data and AI firm is in early talks to raise several billion dollars, up from a $190bn valuation, showing private AI deals continue despite the public-market slump.

items.t: OpenAI explains ChatGPT outage that failed 75% of requests
items.d: A database maintenance job knocked out read replicas that login services relied on, breaking ChatGPT for paid and free users for about 3.5 hours on Friday. OpenAI published fixes.

items.t: Google opens Genie 4 world model to developers
items.d: Genie 4, which generates playable 720p worlds with sound in real time, is now in the Gemini API and AI Studio, priced at roughly 10 cents per second of video.

items.t: Coding-AI start-up Cognition eyes $75bn valuation
items.d: The maker of the Devin coding agent is reportedly raising over $2bn, up from $48bn in September, as AI coding tools remain the hottest area for investors.

items.t: Amazon nears $7.5bn deal for AI start-up Decart
items.d: Decart makes AI models run efficiently across Nvidia, Google and Amazon chips. The deal would help Amazon cut AI costs on its own Trainium hardware, the FT reported.

items.t: Webb sees a star swallow another in Andromeda
items.d: A small star spiralled into a supergiant and merged, creating a new star nicknamed 'Bao'. Webb caught it 47 days after the flare, the earliest such follow-up, published in Nature.

items.t: NASA fires new Moon rocket engine for full 200 seconds
items.d: A developmental RS-25 engine test at Stennis will help make engines for the SLS rocket more powerful and reliable, ahead of the crewed Artemis IV Moon landing planned for 2028.

items.t: Energy price cap forecast to jump 26% in January
items.d: Cornwall Insight expects the cap to reach £2,166, adding over £400 a year to typical bills; Ofgem confirms on Wednesday. Charities say the government's £100 payment is 'a drop in the ocean'.

items.t: Burnham defends EU deal as universities warn of costs
items.d: The PM says the deal, cutting red tape on food exports, helps ordinary people. But the EU wants home-rate fees for EU students, which university leaders say would hit their finances.

items.t: Last-ditch talks to stop Tube drivers' strike on Thursday
items.d: RMT drivers plan a 24-hour walkout from noon Thursday over a voluntary four-day week. Talks are set for Tuesday, with more strike dates into February.

items.t: 俄導彈落入波蘭境內
items.d: 俄羅斯向烏克蘭發射逾400架無人機及110多枚導彈期間，兩枚導彈及一架無人機落入波蘭東南部，無人受傷。總理圖斯克指這是蓄意挑釁，波蘭或要求北約磋商。

items.t: 伊朗加強攻擊海灣　一周25艘油輪中招
items.d: 伊斯蘭革命衞隊稱襲擊巴林美軍雷達。霍爾木茲海峽一帶七日內約25艘油輪被擊中，油價一度突破100美元，其後回落至約83美元。

items.t: AI股拋售加劇　Anthropic上市後下跌
items.d: Anthropic首個完整交易日股價跌近一成，Nvidia及AMD亦跌約一成。投資者憂慮估值過高及靠借貸支撐的數據中心投資。

items.t: 伊朗與卡塔爾斡旋代表在德黑蘭會談
items.d: 伊朗稱若美國結束戰爭、解凍資產及撤銷石油制裁，重開霍爾木茲海峽「並不困難」。特朗普表示希望達成永久協議，目前仍未算正式談判。

items.t: 受制裁俄貨輪遭無人機擊中　在芬蘭外海焚燒
items.d: 駛往加里寧格勒的Sparta II號起火後漂入芬蘭水域，16名船員全部撤離。芬蘭指相信是烏克蘭所為，警告戰火正蔓延至波羅的海。

items.t: 加沙流離失所者抗議　以軍空襲持續
items.d: 數百人在代爾拜萊赫示威。加沙衞生部指2025年10月停火以來已有1,661人死亡，馬加齊一個月內逾500個住宅單位被毀。

items.t: 印尼糖果廠大火　3死36失蹤
items.d: 火警發生在雅加達附近萬丹省一幢三層高工廠，當時約60人在內。大火燒逾12小時，起火原因仍在調查。

items.t: Oracle集資200億美元支持OpenAI數據中心合約
items.d: Oracle發行約200億美元新股及債券，稱與OpenAI的巨額合約已有足夠資金；此前其股價因AI債務憂慮大跌。

items.t: Apollo與高盛安排440億美元SpaceX晶片融資
items.d: 資金用於購買租予SpaceX的Nvidia晶片，是至今最大型AI硬件融資之一，反映AI擴張愈來愈依賴借貸。

items.t: Databricks洽集資　估值達2,250億美元
items.d: 這家數據及AI公司正初步商討集資數十億美元，估值較早前的1,900億美元上升，顯示公開市場下跌下私募AI交易仍然熾熱。

items.t: OpenAI交代ChatGPT大故障　75%請求失敗
items.d: 一項數據庫維護工作令登入服務依賴的讀取副本失效，ChatGPT付費及免費用戶周五約3.5小時無法使用，OpenAI已公布改善措施。

items.t: Google向開發者開放Genie 4世界模型
items.d: 可即時生成720p、附聲音的互動世界的Genie 4登上Gemini API及AI Studio，影片收費約每秒10美仙。

items.t: AI編程初創Cognition估值或達750億美元
items.d: 開發Devin編程助手的Cognition據報集資逾20億美元，估值較9月的480億美元大升，AI編程工具仍是投資者至愛。

items.t: Amazon擬斥75億美元收購AI初創Decart
items.d: Decart令AI模型在Nvidia、Google及Amazon晶片上都能高效運行。據《金融時報》報道，交易有助Amazon降低自家Trainium晶片的AI成本。

items.t: 韋伯望遠鏡目睹仙女座星系「吞星」
items.d: 一顆細小恆星螺旋墜入超巨星並合併，新恆星暱稱「Bao」。韋伯在爆發後47日觀測，是同類事件最早的跟進觀測，研究刊於《自然》。

items.t: NASA登月火箭引擎完成200秒點火測試
items.d: 在史坦尼斯中心進行的RS-25發展型引擎測試，有助提升SLS火箭引擎的推力及可靠性，為2028年載人登月的Artemis IV任務作準備。

items.t: 能源價格上限明年1月料升26%
items.d: Cornwall Insight預計上限升至2,166英鎊，一般家庭每年多付逾400英鎊，Ofgem周三公布。慈善團體批評政府100英鎊補貼「杯水車薪」。

items.t: 賓咸力撐歐盟協議　大學憂財政受損
items.d: 首相賓咸稱協議減少食品出口繁文縟節，惠及普通市民。但歐盟要求英國向歐盟學生收本地學費，大學校長警告財政將受打擊。

items.t: 地鐵車長周四罷工　勞資最後談判
items.d: RMT工會車長計劃周四中午起罷工24小時，反對自願四天工作周安排。雙方周二談判，其後罷工日期延至明年2月。
